findings.issue: DepViolation.message is present in implementation but not listed in ADR §3 minimal type definition (which specifies only type, registryDefId, fieldKey). The field is additive and mirrors BindingViolation per NF-1, but the spec FR-3 also omits it, leaving a documentation gap.
findings.suggestion: When ADR/spec is updated for T-0177, explicitly add 'message: string' to ADR §3 DepViolation interface to close documentation gap. No code change needed.

findings.issue: classifyReportPageFloor filter sub-paths for missing filter.field_key and missing filter.value are not explicitly tested. Implementation handles both correctly (lines 199-207) but test coverage is incomplete for these internal branches.
findings.suggestion: Add two test cases: (1) filter:{op:'=', value:42} with no field_key → Floor-2; (2) filter:{field_key:'f', op:'='} with no value → Floor-2. Nit — does not block T-0177.
